<thought>Based on the observed series of peaks spaced by ~1 Da and decreasing in intensity, the pattern matches the typical isotopic envelope of a molecule containing many carbon atoms (C‑12/C‑13). No other element shows a comparable multi‑peak +1 Da series in the data, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
